DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落とし物のお届けですね。どのような物を拾われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are handing in a lost item, then. What did you find?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩道に落ちていた青い定期入れです。中を開けずに持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未開封の青い定期入れを歩道で拾ったと届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A blue pass holder that was lying on the sidewalk. I brought it in without opening it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you found an unopened blue pass holder on the sidewalk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見つけた場所を、近くの建物などで説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you describe where you found it using nearby buildings or other landmarks?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 交差点の近くのパン屋の前です。ただ、店の名前は覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: パン屋前の交差点付近と説明し店名不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: In front of a bakery near an intersection. However, I do not remember the shop's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the location near an intersection in front of a bakery, and say you do not know the shop's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 店名が分からなくても、地図で位置を示せますか。拾った時刻も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even without the shop's name, can you point out the location on a map? I will also ask when you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この角の歩道です。買い物のレシートが十時なので、その少し後に見つけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図で位置を示しレシートから十時過ぎと推定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: On the sidewalk at this corner. My shopping receipt says ten o'clock, so I found it a little after that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out the location on the map and estimate from the receipt that it was just after ten. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 十時過ぎ頃ですね。拾う前に、落とした人を見かけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Around a little after ten, then. Before picking it up, did you see the person who dropped it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 誰が落としたかは見ていません。通った人を持ち主だと決めつけたくないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 落とした人を見ておらず通行人を持ち主と断定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I did not see who dropped it. I do not want to assume that someone passing by was the owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you did not see who dropped it and will not identify a passerby as the owner without evidence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見たことと、分からないことを分けて記録します。お名前などの記入欄もご説明しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record what you saw separately from what you do not know. I will also explain the fields for your name and other details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記入前に説明を聞きます。店名と正確な時刻が不明なことも、記録に残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記入説明を頼み店名と正確な時刻の不明点も記録してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will listen to the explanation before filling it in. Please also record that I do not know the shop's name or the exact time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation of how to fill it in, and have the unknown shop name and exact time recorded as well. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その点も記録します。お届けいただきありがとうございました、お気を付けてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will record those points too. Thank you for handing it in. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 差し出す前に、宛名の書き方を確認なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check how to write the recipient's address before posting it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人宛ての封筒です。部屋番号はありますが、建物名を書く場所が足りなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛先の部屋番号は書いたが建物名を書く余白が不足すると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This envelope is for a friend. I have included the room number, but I have run out of space for the building name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote the destination room number but lack space for the building name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ封をしていなければ、新しい封筒に書き直す方法もあります。住所の元の情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you have not sealed it yet, you could rewrite it on a new envelope. Do you have the original address information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人からのメッセージがあります。省略せずに書き直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人のメッセージを元に住所を省略せず書き直す希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a message from my friend. I would like to rewrite the address without leaving anything out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to rewrite the full address without omissions, using your friend's message. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、宛先の郵便番号から確認しましょう。番地の後に建物名と部屋番号を続けて書けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's start by checking the destination postal code. You can write the building name and room number after the street address numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この二行目に建物名、その下に部屋番号を書けば、読みにくくなりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 建物名と部屋番号を別行に配置してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I write the building name on this second line and the room number below it, will it still be easy to read?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can put the building name and room number on separate lines. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所としてまとまって読めるように、行の間隔を空けすぎないでください。宛名は別の行にしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not leave too much space between the lines, so they can be read together as one address. Put the recipient's name on a separate line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分の住所は、封筒の裏に書くつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 差出人住所を封筒裏へ記入する予定を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I plan to write my own address on the back of the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State your plan to write the sender's address on the back of the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 差出人が分かるよう、お名前も添えてください。書き直した封筒を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please include your name too so the sender can be identified. Could you show me the rewritten envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 建物名と部屋番号を入れ直しました。裏にも自分の住所と名前を書いたので、差し出す前に確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 建物名部屋番号と差出人情報を記入して最終照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have rewritten it to include the building name and room number. I also wrote my address and name on the back, so please check it before I post it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you entered the building name, room number, and sender information, and ask for a final check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 建物名も部屋番号も読めますね。お立ち寄りいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Both the building name and room number are legible. Thank you for stopping by.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込先の情報をお持ちですか。まだ操作を始めていなければ、一緒に項目を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have the recipient's bank transfer details? If you have not started the transaction yet, let's look at the fields together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相手からこのメッセージが届きました。銀行名と支店名が続いていて、区切りが分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: メッセージ内の銀行名と支店名の区切りが不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The recipient sent me this message. The bank name and branch name run together, and I cannot tell where one ends and the other begins.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot tell the boundary between the bank name and branch name in the message. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 銀行名、支店名、口座の種類、番号の順に分けて確認します。原文を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will separate and check the bank name, branch name, account type, and number in that order. Could you show me the original message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 原文はこちらです。この部分が支店名かどうか、相手にも聞いた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原文を示して支店名の解釈を相手に確認すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the original message. Should I also ask the recipient whether this part is the branch name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the original message and ask whether to confirm your interpretation of the branch name with the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 曖昧な情報は相手に確かめてください。こちらで推測して入力するのは避けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check any unclear information with the recipient. Let's avoid guessing and entering it ourselves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、支店名だけを別に送ってもらいます。口座の種類も書かれていないので、一緒に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 支店名を単独で送ってもらい未記載の口座種類も問い合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will ask them to send the branch name on its own. The account type is not written either, so I will ask about that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to have the branch name sent separately and ask about the missing account type as well. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手の回答を受け取ってから、入力する内容をそろえましょう。振込を急ぐ必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you receive their reply, let's gather everything you need to enter. Is there any need to hurry the transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日中と頼まれましたが、情報が確認できるまでは送らないことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日中の依頼でも情報確認前には振込しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: They asked me to do it today, but I have decided not to send the money until the information is confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide not to make the transfer before confirming the information, even though you were asked to do it today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その旨を相手に伝えて、確認が済んだらまたご相談ください。まだ振込の操作はしていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell them that, and come back to us once you have confirmed it. You have not started the transfer procedure yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 操作はしていません。支店名と口座の種類を確認した回答を持って、改めて来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未操作であると伝え確認済み情報を持って再来する予定を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have not. I will come back with their reply confirming the branch name and account type.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have not started the procedure and will return with confirmed information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 必要な情報がそろってからお手伝いします。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will help once you have all the necessary information. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 棚の表示をお探しですか。同じような袋が並んでいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the shelf label? There are several similar bags here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この二つは見た目が似ています。下の値札は、どちらの袋の値段ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た二種類の袋と棚下の値札の対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: These two look similar. Which bag's price is the price tag below for?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how the price tag below the shelf corresponds to two similar types of bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 値札の商品名と容量を照らし合わせましょう。こちらは大きい袋の表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's compare the product name and quantity on the price tag. This label is for the large bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大きい方は家で使い切れなさそうです。小さい袋の容量はどこに書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 使い切れない大袋を避け小袋の内容量記載を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not think I could use up the large one at home. Where is the quantity of the small bag written?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid the large bag you cannot use up, and ask where the small bag's net quantity is shown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋の裏側に内容量の欄があります。小袋の百五十グラムと、大袋の四百グラムを比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a net quantity field on the back of the bag. Compare the small bag's 150 grams with the large bag's 400 grams.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋と値札の数字が同じでした。小さい方を二つ買うと、量は大きい一袋より少ないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小袋と値札の容量を照合し二袋と大袋の量を比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The numbers on the bag and price tag matched. So if I buy two small bags, that is less than one large bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Match the small bag's quantity to the price tag and compare two small bags with one large bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 容量を足すとそうなります。値段も一袋ずつの表示なので、二袋なら合計を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is right when you add the quantities. The prices are also per bag, so check the total if you buy two.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今回は小さい方を一袋にします。値札の名前も、袋と同じかもう一度見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小袋一袋を選び商品名の一致を再確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This time I will take one small bag. I will check once more that the name on the price tag matches the bag too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose one small bag and check again that the product names match. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一致していますね。レジで表示が違うと感じたら、支払う前にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: They match. If you think the display is different at the checkout, please let us know before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 容量と商品名が一致したので、この一袋を持ってレジへ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容量と商品名が一致した一袋を選んでレジへ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The quantity and product name match, so I will take this one bag to the checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the bag whose quantity and product name match, and go to the checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お選びいただきありがとうございます。それでは、ごゆっくりお買い物なさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for choosing. Please enjoy the rest of your shopping at your leisure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図の現在地をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for your current location on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と噴水の前で待ち合わせましたが、囲いがあって噴水が見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 噴水の待ち合わせ場所が囲いで見えない状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I arranged to meet a friend in front of the fountain, but there is a barrier and I cannot see the fountain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a barrier prevents you from seeing the fountain where you arranged to meet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図のこの部分が工事区画です。囲いの中へ入らず、別の目印を決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This part of the map is the construction area. Let's choose another landmark without going inside the barrier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今いる入口に変更したいです。入口が複数あるので、名前を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 集合場所を今の入口へ変えるため入口名を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to change the meeting place to the entrance where I am now. There are several entrances, so please tell me its name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the entrance name so you can change the meeting place to your current entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在地の欄に入口名が書かれています。入口脇の案内板にも同じ名前があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The entrance name is written in the current location section. The information board beside the entrance has the same name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内板の名前を確認できました。友人が反対側にいる場合、どの道から来てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口名を照合し反対側から工事を避ける経路を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have checked the name on the information board. If my friend is on the opposite side, which route can I ask them to take?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Match the entrance name and ask about a route from the opposite side that avoids the construction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 工事区画を避ける道は、図の外側を回る経路です。歩いてよい道の表示も一緒に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The route avoiding the construction area goes around the outside on the map. Please also check the markings for paths you are allowed to walk on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外側の経路を案内図で示して送ります。私はこの案内板の横で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外側経路の図を友人へ送り案内板横で待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will mark the outside route on the map and send it. I will wait beside this information board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will send your friend a map of the outside route and wait beside the information board. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 人の通行を妨げないよう、通路を空けてお待ちくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the walkway clear as you wait so you do not obstruct people passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通路から少し離れた案内板の横に立ち、入口名も友人に送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路を空けて立つ位置を選び入口名も友人に送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will stand beside the information board, a little away from the walkway, and send my friend the entrance name too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose where to stand to keep the walkway clear and send your friend the entrance name as well. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その目印なら伝えやすいですね。それでは、待ち合わせがうまくいきますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: That landmark should be easy to explain. I hope you meet up successfully.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお困りですか。切符をお調べしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is something wrong? Shall I check your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯の電池が切れて、乗り換えの続きが見られません。津山まで行く予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯の電池切れで経路を見られないと伝え行き先を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My phone's battery has died, so I cannot see the rest of my transfer route. I am planning to go to Tsuyama.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your phone's battery is dead so you cannot view the route, and give your destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 津山までですね。すでに切符はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: To Tsuyama, then. Do you already have a ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 切符はありますが、どの列車に乗るかは画面に保存したままでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切符を持っているが列車情報を確認できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a ticket, but the information on which trains to take was still saved on the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a ticket but cannot check the train information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切符を拝見して、今から利用できる列車を時刻表で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me see your ticket and check the timetable for trains you can take from now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗り換えがある場合は、その駅名と出発時刻を紙に書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗換駅と出発時刻を紙に記すよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: If there is a transfer, could you write the station name and departure time on paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to have the transfer station and departure time written on paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お書きしますね。携帯が使えない間も、途中の駅で係員に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will write them down. Even while you cannot use your phone, you can check with staff at stations along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 助かります。乗り換えの時間が短ければ、一本後でも構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 余裕のある乗換時間を優先したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: That helps. If the transfer time is short, I do not mind taking the next train instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to prioritize having enough time to transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、時間に余裕のある経路を選んで、乗る列車を順番に記します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I will choose a route with plenty of time and write the trains you will take in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この紙を持って移動します。最初の列車の乗り場だけ、最後に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙を利用すると伝えて最初の乗り場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will travel with this paper. Finally, please just tell me where to board the first train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use the paper and ask where to board the first train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 乗り場を確認してこちらに書きますね。途中でも迷ったら係員に尋ねて、気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the boarding location and write it here. If you get confused along the way, ask station staff. Have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの封筒についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the envelope you have brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 以前の家にこの通知が届き、大家さんから渡されました。住所変更が反映されていないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧住所へ届いた通知を示して住所変更の反映を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This notice arrived at my former home, and the landlord gave it to me. Does that mean my address change has not been reflected?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show a notice delivered to your old address and ask whether your address change has been reflected. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 差出元と発行日を確認させてください。引っ越されたのはいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me check the sender and issue date. When did you move?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先月十日です。転入の手続きは、その週に済ませました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 転居日と転入手続きの時期を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the tenth of last month. I completed the move-in registration that same week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your moving date and when you completed the move-in registration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通知を作った時期と変更の時期が前後した可能性もあります。発送した部署へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The preparation of the notice and the change may have crossed over in timing. I will check with the department that sent it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ通知がまた旧住所に届かないかも、あわせて調べてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今後旧住所へ通知が届かないか確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would also like you to check whether the same notice might be sent to my old address again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to have it checked whether notices might be sent to the old address in future. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在登録されている住所と、通知の宛先の情報を照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's compare your currently registered address with the destination details on the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の住所を書いた控えがあります。通知に返信が必要かも分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在住所の控えを提示して返信の必要性を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a copy showing my current address. I also do not know whether I need to reply to the notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show a copy of your current address and ask whether a reply is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返信の要否は通知を担当する部署に聞きましょう。封筒と中の用紙を一緒にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's ask the department responsible for the notice whether a reply is needed. Please bring both the envelope and the sheet inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 両方を持って担当部署へ行きます。住所の照合もそこでお願いすればよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当部署に封筒と通知を持参して住所照合を依頼すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take both to the responsible department. I should ask them to compare the addresses there too, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will take the envelope and notice to the responsible department and ask them to compare the addresses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、窓口へ事情を伝えておきます。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, I will tell the counter staff about the situation. Thank you for speaking with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察をお待ちですね。今日はお変わりありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are waiting for your consultation, correct? Has anything changed today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 体調は前回と同じです。今日は診察が終わったら仕事へ戻る予定で来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 症状が変わらないことと診察後に仕事へ戻る予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My condition is the same as last time. I came today planning to return to work after the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your symptoms are unchanged and you plan to return to work after the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診察後の検査について、何か指示は受けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you received any instructions about tests after the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前回、次は検査をするかもしれないと言われましたが、予約票には診察としかありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前回の検査の話と今回の予約票の記載の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last time I was told I might have a test next time, but the appointment slip only says consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the previous discussion of testing and the wording on this appointment slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な検査は診察で先生が判断します。お仕事の予定も先にお伝えしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The doctor will decide at the consultation which tests are needed. Let's tell them your work plans in advance too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 午後一時までに戻る必要があります。検査が必要なら、その場で日程を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場へ戻る期限を示して必要な検査の日程を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I need to be back by one in the afternoon. If a test is needed, I would like to discuss scheduling it there and then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your deadline for returning to work and say you want to discuss scheduling any necessary tests. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのご希望を先生に伝えますね。戻る時刻に間に合うとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell the doctor your request. We cannot promise you will make it back in time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。終わる時刻が読めないことを、職場にも今のうちに連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 終了時刻が不明なことを職場へ連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will let my workplace know now that I cannot predict the finishing time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your workplace that the finishing time is uncertain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そうしていただけると安心ですね。呼ばれたときに分かるよう、待合室でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: That would give you peace of mind. Please wait in the waiting room so you can hear when you are called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 短く電話してから待合室に戻ります。名前を呼ばれたら聞こえる所で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電話後に呼び出しが聞こえる待合室へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will make a short phone call and return to the waiting room. I will wait somewhere I can hear my name being called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return after the call to the waiting room where you can hear the call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お戻りになったらこちらにも声をかけてください。お話しくださってありがとうございました、お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please let us know when you return too. Thank you for explaining. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落とし物を拾われたんですね。どのような物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You found a lost item, then. What is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鍵が二本付いた輪です。道路脇に落ちていたので持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾った鍵の本数と道路脇で発見したことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A ring with two keys attached. It was lying by the road, so I brought it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State how many keys you found and that you discovered them by the road. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拾った場所と時刻を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you tell me where and when you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝七時ごろ、駅へ向かう道の自動販売機の横で拾いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 鍵を拾った時刻と自動販売機の横という位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around seven this morning, beside a vending machine on the road to the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain when you found the keys and their location beside a vending machine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 自動販売機の場所を特定したいので、周りの建物も覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I would like to pinpoint the vending machine's location. Do you also remember any surrounding buildings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 向かいに青い看板の理髪店があります。地図なら場所を指せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 周囲の建物を示して地図で場所を指せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a barbershop with a blue sign opposite. I can point out the location on a map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the nearby building and say you can point out the location on a map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、こちらの地図でお願いします。持ち主の手がかりになる札などはありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please use this map. Was there a tag or anything else that might identify the owner?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 白い札は付いていますが、何も書いてありません。鍵を試したりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無記名の札と鍵を試していないことを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a white tag, but nothing is written on it. I have not tried using the keys.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the blank tag and that you have not tried the keys. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのままお預かりしますね。拾われた方への手続きについてもご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will take it just as it is. I will also explain the procedure for the person who found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いてから記入します。連絡先はこの用紙に書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手続き説明を聞くと伝えて連絡先の記入欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will fill it in after hearing the explanation. Should I write my contact details on this form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will listen to the procedure explanation and ask where to enter your contact details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記入する欄をご案内します。届けていただいてありがとうございます、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will show you the fields to fill in. Thank you for handing it in. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒は、切手を貼ってありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This envelope already has stamps on it, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 最初は手紙だけでしたが、あとから資料を足しました。この切手のままで足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 資料追加後の封筒の切手料金が足りるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: At first it was only a letter, but I added some documents later. Are the current stamps enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the postage on the envelope is enough after adding documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 重さと大きさを測って確認します。追加した資料は何枚ほどですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check by measuring its weight and size. About how many sheets did you add?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十二枚足しました。厚くなったので、ポストに入れる前に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追加枚数と厚くなったため投函を控えた経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Twelve. It became thicker, so I came here before putting it in a postbox.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain how many sheets you added and that you held off posting it because it became thicker. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お持ちいただいてよかったです。測った結果で、この封筒に必要な料金をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I am glad you brought it in. Based on the measurements, I will tell you the postage needed for this envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 足りない分の切手を買ってここで出したいです。今貼ってある切手は使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不足分を購入して窓口発送したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to buy stamps for the shortfall and send it here. Can I use the stamps already attached?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to buy the additional postage and send the envelope at the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 貼ってある切手を確認して、追加が必要な金額を計算しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the attached stamps and calculate the additional amount needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 切手が重ならないように貼りたいので、空いている場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 切手が重ならず宛名も隠さない貼付位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to attach the stamps without overlapping them, so please show me an empty space.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where to attach the stamps without overlapping them or covering the recipient's address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちら側に並べれば宛名を隠しません。計算が済むまで、お貼りにならずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you line them up on this side, they will not cover the recipient's address. Please wait without attaching them until the calculation is finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 金額が決まってから貼ります。資料をもう一度確かめて、封も閉じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 料金確定後に貼り資料を確認して封を閉じると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will attach them once the amount is settled. I will check the documents once more and seal the envelope too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will attach the stamps after the postage is confirmed, check the documents, and seal the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 閉じたらこちらでお受けします。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once it is sealed, we will accept it here. Thank you for using our service.
